title: Who’s asking? User personas and the mechanics of latent misalignment
reasoning: The paper evaluates how Large Language Models (LLMs) respond to harmful queries based on the user's persona, which includes specific religious identities (Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Atheist) and moral/behavioral attributes (altruistic, selfish, law-abiding, etc.). It explores the model's 'judgment' and 'charitable interpretations' based on these traits.
